children: Host Digital announced a set of post-merger agreements to support liquidity and growth. The company entered Registration Rights Agreements with certain stockholders to register the resale of common stock issued in the merger, committing to file a shelf within 30 days and keep it effective until all covered shares are sold. Separately, Host Digital signed a two-year Preferential Rights Agreement with Host Infrastructure Holdings that provides a right of first offer and a right of first refusal on sponsor-affiliated project site subsidiaries, enhancing visibility into a potential development pipeline.
Agreement 1: Host Digital Sets Post-Merger Registration Rights to Enable Share Resale by Key Holders
: Registration rights agreements for resale of common stock
: Until all registrable securities are sold
: Provide liquidity to holders and support capital markets access
Agreement 2: Host Digital Secures Two-Year ROFO/ROFR Pipeline Agreement With Host Infrastructure Holdings
: Preferential Rights Agreement (ROFO/ROFR on project subsidiaries)
: Secure pipeline of potential project acquisitions
